name: a plan cuts — joins are typed and at least one is a cut
input: A 150 second film: a courier must hand a sealed case to a skeptical broker who tests every word before accepting it. Both are new faces, one location, call it THE BACK OFFICE. The broker's doubt is the opposition. Terse, coiled. Plan it and put the sequence up for my approval.
why: creator note on the first 60s pilot: "No storytelling in the shot" — every join had been rendered as a frame-chained continuation, producing one drifting take with no cuts; joins must be declared, and an all-continuous plan is the failure mode

provenance.note: creator, 2026-08-31: no storytelling in the shot
